trial_type.Description: Stimulus language / category from the release file name

word.Description: Stimulus word from the release file name; the audio and mel-spectrogram are stimuli/audio/sub<N>_listen_audio/<word>_<language>.wav and stimuli/mel/

source_index.Description: Trial index in the release file name (1-based)

source_file.Description: Release .npy file name of this trial

sample.Description: First sample of the epoch in the BrainVision file (0-based)
